scope: Coalesce identity-bound vault authentication and restore truthful Apps connection status after a transient failure

source.definition: Sorted tracked and nonignored untracked JS/Python/shell/config/HTML/CSS/Markdown sources; path + NUL + LF-normalized UTF-8 + NUL. Deployment evidence subdirectories excluded.

vault.sharedStateScope: One service instance and exact origin/client ID/client secret identity
checks: Cold and expired-token login fanout is coalesced
Failed login releases the flight for a later caller
Instances and identities do not share authentication state
Origin, client ID and client-secret rotation invalidate reuse
Stale completion cannot publish a token or clear a newer flight
Configuration candidate token remains unpublished until atomic save
Failed configuration authentication or persistence preserves the active identity
Configuration commits are ordered and advance a generation even for the same identity
Identity removal and restoration cannot revive an older flight
Status contains no token, client secret or identity digest
Secret values are not cached and failed secret operations are not automatically replayed

appsConnection.case: Ready state, HTTP 503, then identical successful state JSON

limitations: This measures login coalescing with synthetic responses, not production account-wide quota savings
Tests do not prove deployed shop quality, live account billing or full OS credential isolation
Last activation attempt was not accepted by the provider; publication does not establish activation
Candidate-exec mode, UID separation and the other optional proposals remain unapproved and unimplemented
Raw private logs, secret values and application data are not published
